body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Madrid, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2.5 hours, over a route of about 2.5 km. It starts at Thyssen-Bornezmiza Museum Entrance, Paseo del Prado, 8. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Elena as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the mesmerizing world of art like never before with our captivating audio tour of the renowned Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum. Immerse yourself in the rich cultural tapestry of one of the most esteemed art collections in the world, right at your fingertips.
>
> Considered one of the top 10 museums in Europe and one of the 50 best art galleries in the world, Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum offers a fascinating journey through the history of art. The museum is famous for its unique collection which includes nearly one thousand works from the major periods and multiple art movements and schools such as the Renaissance, Baroque, Romanticism, Pop Art — masterpieces from 13th-century to the late 20th-century.
>
> The audio tour offers an unrivaled opportunity to explore the masterpieces housed within the walls of this iconic museum at your own pace. As you wander through the galleries, allow the expertly crafted narratives to transport you into the minds of legendary artists, unveiling the stories behind their remarkable creations.
>
> Embark on an enlightening and awe-inspiring journey through the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum and let the magic of art transport you to extraordinary realms of beauty and creativity.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.94. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 166 ratings and 56 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
